title: Wade: AI Bosses ‘Genuinely Worried’
summary: US President Donald Trump has waded into the AI safety debate raging between Silicon Valley and Washington. In a rapid-fire series of social media posts, Trump belittled a push led by Anthropic and OpenAI bosses to slow work on cutting-edge systems and dismissed the existential fears about AI as “a hoax.” Michael Wade, Professor of Strategy and Digital at the IMD business school in Switzerland spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on the need for AI guardrails. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Treasury 10-Year Yield Rises Past 5%, Oil Advances: Markets Wrap

title: Moody’s to Buy Minority Stake in Philippine Credit Rating Agency
summary: Moody’s Corp. has agreed to acquire a minority stake in Philippine Rating Services Corp. as the global credit ratings firm looks to tap the growth of debt markets in the Philippines and across Southeast Asia.

title: Tata Sons’ Listed Shareholders Rally After RBI Renews IPO Push

title: Indian Bonds Sink on Central Bank Debt-Sale Plan, Global Selloff
summary: Indian bonds declined after the central bank said it would sell sovereign notes to drain cash from lenders, adding to the supply of debt in a year when the market is already under pressure from record government borrowing.

summary: Japan’s 20-year government bond auction Tuesday saw stronger demand than the 12-month average as elevated yields underpinned buying.

title: Nickel Producer Halts Plant Ramp-Up on Indonesian Water Shortage

title: South Korea Plans Fewer Towers in Expansion of Electricity Grid
